labels.shortDescription: Health Check detail: Setup and Open Impact fiscal year start months differ
labels.value: Open Impact starts its fiscal year in {0}, and the fiscal year in Setup starts in {1}. Every year based total Open Impact calculates is measured from the first, and reports grouped by fiscal year are measured from the second, so the two disagree and nothing else in the app will say so. Set both to the same month, then recalculate rollups.

labels.shortDescription: Title of the fiscal year mismatch finding.
labels.value: Your two fiscal years do not match

labels.shortDescription: Fix refused: what it would change is not what the finding said.
labels.value: Something changed since Health Check last ran, so this fix would not do exactly what you confirmed. Nothing was changed. Health Check has run again: read the finding and press its button again if it is still there.

labels.shortDescription: Explains why contact membership does not work with Person Accounts.
labels.value: Person Accounts are enabled, but household membership is still set to use the person's account. In a Person Accounts org the person is an account, so households built that way do not work. Switching to junction membership fixes it, and the households you already have are not changed.

labels.shortDescription: Button that switches household membership to the junction.
labels.value: Switch to junction membership

labels.shortDescription: Title of the household membership finding.
labels.value: Household membership does not fit Person Accounts

labels.shortDescription: Explains that the coexistence mode matches the org.
labels.value: This org is set to {0}, which is what Open Impact recommends for what is installed here.

labels.shortDescription: Title of the finding shown when the mode matches.
labels.value: Coexistence mode matches your org

labels.shortDescription: Explains that the coexistence mode does not match the org.
labels.value: This org is set to {0}, but what is installed points to {1}. If that is deliberate, leave it. If it is not, switch: households and imports behave differently in each mode.

labels.shortDescription: Title of the mode mismatch finding.
labels.value: Coexistence mode does not match your org

labels.shortDescription: Explains that nobody has confirmed a coexistence mode.
labels.value: Open Impact is running as {0} because nobody has confirmed a mode yet. This org looks like {1}. Confirm it before you create households or load data.

labels.shortDescription: Title of the finding shown when no mode is confirmed.
labels.value: Coexistence mode is not confirmed yet

labels.shortDescription: Explains that multiple currencies are not supported yet.
labels.value: Open Impact does not convert between currencies yet. Nothing will break, but totals add up amounts as they were entered. Keep amounts in one currency until currency support ships.

labels.shortDescription: Title of the multi-currency finding.
labels.value: This org uses more than one currency

labels.shortDescription: Health Check detail: nightly run off. {0} waiting rollups, {1} nightly only.
labels.value: {0} active totals are set to recalculate in the nightly run, and it is not scheduled. {1} of them recalculate only then, so their values are not being kept up to date. The fix schedules the run every night at 2:00 AM. Stop it on the Rollups page.

labels.shortDescription: Fix button: schedule the nightly rollup run.
labels.value: Schedule the nightly run

labels.shortDescription: Health Check title: the nightly rollup run is not scheduled.
labels.value: Nightly totals are not scheduled

labels.shortDescription: Explains that nobody holds the Nonprofit Admin role.
labels.value: Nobody in this org has the Open Impact Admin role, so nobody can change settings and parts of Open Impact will refuse to run. Assign it to yourself on the Access page.

labels.shortDescription: Title of the missing administrator finding.
labels.value: No one is assigned the Open Impact Admin role

labels.shortDescription: Shown when there is nothing to report.
labels.value: Nothing to report. Open Impact is set up correctly.

labels.shortDescription: Explains that no new person is getting a household.
labels.value: Household membership uses membership records, and "create a household automatically" is off, so no person saved from now on gets a household. Nothing fails and nothing is logged while this is true: the people saved in the meantime simply have to be grouped by hand later. Turn automatic households on unless your org deliberately groups people another way.

labels.value: Turn on automatic households

labels.shortDescription: Health Check detail: contacts with no account, in contact mode.
labels.value: These contacts have no account, so they are in no household: they count toward no household total, and no household name or greeting includes them. A contact whose account is an organization is not counted. Open each one and set its account to a household. Health Check finds these and does not change them; cleaning them up in bulk belongs to the data hygiene console.

labels.shortDescription: Health Check detail: people with no current membership, junction mode.
labels.value: No current household membership names these people, so they are in no household: they count toward no household total, and no household name or greeting includes them. Open each one and add them to a household from its members panel. Health Check finds these and does not change them; cleaning them up in bulk belongs to the data hygiene console.

labels.shortDescription: Health Check title: people in no household. {0} count or more than.
labels.value: {0} people are not in a household
